== Notes ==
* Blind [[cover]]s cracked armor.
* Because this is not a spell, this will not count for the 10 spell count in [[Glyph of Elemental Power]] or {{gr|1|3}} spell count in [[Glyph of Energy]], but will still get the stat boost.
* Cracked armor is applied after the damage is dealt.
